description: Phase 1 feature taxonomy mapping GSS variable names to one of {primary_eval, sensitivity_eval, demographic, behavioral, psychological, attitudinal, exclude}. Locked in writing before pipeline runs; identical to OSF pre-registration content.
design:
Path A* (Path B as primary, Path A as sensitivity):
  - primary_eval: 12 high-variance items, one per construct family. LOO ablation runs against this.
  - sensitivity_eval: full Park v2 eval list (~120 items). For per-item Park comparability. No LOO.
  - demographic / behavioral / psychological / attitudinal: feature pool, partitioned for the 4-bin LOO.
  - exclude: variables NOT used (utility/meta/derived).
Disjointness: each variable appears in exactly one bin. Eval items NEVER appear in feature bins.
missingness_rule: GSS ballot rotation means not every respondent gets every item. For each (respondent, item), if value is in the missing-codes set {-100..-40} we treat it as absent and EXCLUDE that item from that respondent's feature/eval set. We do NOT impute.

primary_eval._note: Path B's 12 curated items. Each from a different construct family to minimize within-eval auto-correlation.

items.scale_text: 1=Strongly agree ... 4=Strongly disagree (mother working doesn't hurt children)

sensitivity_eval._note: Park v2 Table 3 list (after their 27-item AVP-overlap removal). Used for per-item Park comparability only; no LOO. Items overlap with primary_eval (which is intentional — primary_eval is the headline subset).

feature_bins._note: Phase 1 feature pool, partitioned into 4 bins. LOO ablation drops one bin at a time from the persona prompt. ALL items here are EXCLUDED from primary_eval and sensitivity_eval to enforce disjoint-set leakage hygiene.
feature_bins._resolution_rule:
Two-pass rule:
  PRIMARY ANALYSIS (LOO with primary_eval 12 items):
    - Effective features per bin = (declared bin list) MINUS primary_eval.
    - Items in sensitivity_eval are STILL ALLOWED in feature bins.
    - This keeps the psychological bin populated (HAPPY/SATFIN/HEALTH/LIFE/FAIR/HELPFUL/TRUST etc.
      are all in Park's full eval list but they DO appear in feature bins for primary analysis;
      no leakage because primary_eval items are excluded).
  SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS (Park-comparable per-item prediction over sensitivity_eval):
    - For each predicted sensitivity item X, build the persona prompt from features that EXCLUDE X
      (per-item leakage handling).
    - All other (non-X) sensitivity items remain in features.
Implementation: gss_pipeline.py applies this two-pass rule explicitly.

exclude._note: Variables NOT used in any persona prompt or eval. Includes meta variables, weights, derived/computed indices, sampling-specific items.

_audit_2026-05-02.data_source: GSS 2024 cross-section (3,309 respondents, 973 variables, downloaded via GSS Data Explorer)
_audit_2026-05-02.loader: gss_loader.py — combines 3 batches horizontally into single DataFrame at 3,309 × 973
